title: Synthesis and Tribological Characteristics of High-Performance Self-Lubricating CoCrFeNiMo<sub>x</sub>-Ni/MoS<sub>2</sub>-Ag-Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> Composites.

recollection.intervention: Incorporation of Ni, MoS2, Ag, and Cr2O3 into the alloy matrix
recollection.structure: Self-lubricating composite with a multi-phase microstructure
recollection.mechanism: Synergistic effects of solid lubricants (MoS2, Ag) and hard particles (Cr2O3) to reduce friction and wear
recollection.results: Likely improved tribological performance, such as reduced coefficient of friction and wear rate, under high-load or high-temperature conditions (guess).

score.note: The recollection mostly restates or infers from the title. It lists the composite additives but misses the actual intervention—varying Mo content (x = 0.2, 0.5, 1). The multiphase structure and lubricant/hard-particle synergy are generic and omit the Mo-rich σ phase, lattice distortion, temperature-dependent lubricating films, and high-temperature silver-molybdate/NiO glaze. No quantitative hardness, strength, friction, or wear results are recalled.
